summary: CCSC Technology International Holdings Ltd. (Nasdaq: CCTG) filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into a Technology Purchase Agreement on April 29, 2026, to acquire a smart manufacturing platform from Asia Resource Holdings Ltd. Consideration is 6,333,333 Class A ordinary shares valued at US$3.8 million (US$0.60 per share). The board approved the transaction on April 28, 2026. The seller may assign the right to receive shares to ten assignees. No premium, close date, or break fee is stated. Watch for relevant exchange and regulatory filings as the issuance of shares is subject to future agreements.
